# Engin3D Storage Microservice Skill

Use this skill whenever the task concerns the Engin3D Storage microservice.

## Layers 

### Engin3D Storage

The dedicated Storage (presentation layer - REST) storage is in  `src/server/storage/Engin3D.Storage`

### Engin3D Storage Application

The dedicated Storage Application layer storage is in `src/server/storage/Engin3D.Storage.Application` 

### Engin3D Storage Composition

The dedicated Storage Composition layer (DI) storage is in `src/server/storage/Engin3D.Storage.Composition` 


### Engin3D Storage Domain

The dedicated Storage Domain layer storage is in `src/server/storage/Engin3D.Storage.Domain` 


### Engin3D Storage Infrastructure

The dedicated Storage Infrastructure layer storage is in `src/server/storage/Engin3D.Storage.Infrastructure`
